senses.gloss: (cmp. מְטָא, נְטָא, v. P. Sm. 1591), to incline, turn.
to adduce, prefer. Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ top לית אפשר דלא י׳ מילה it was impossible that he should not have brought on (in his lecture) a word (alluding to the exodus from Egypt); cmp. Bab.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 13b:19">Ber. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>מהדר רבי אשמעתא וכ׳</he>. [Vers. in Fr. Ahǎb. Zion: <he>יָטִיף</he>; ed. Lehm. <cite ref="J00354"><he>יַיְתִי</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A03397"><he>אֲתָא</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>א׳ לי כולבא</he> Ar. s. v. <he>כלב</he> (ed. <he>אייתי … קולב׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62">Yalk. Gen. 62</cite> <cite ref="A02013"><he>אמטי</he></cite>) hand me a pair of tongs (an axe).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>, end <he>דאַיְיטִיאַת וכ׳</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="B01154"><he>ברת</he></cite> (ed. <he>אמטיית</he>), v. <cite ref="A01886"><he>אַלִּיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:9">Koh. R. to III, 9</cite> <he>כל … יַיְטֵי ליה מח וכ׳</he> every one shall bring for himself something whereon to recline.
